result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner has critically low text contrast making it nearly unreadable. No other visually broken elements were found.

issues.description: Promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white on a very light mint background, resulting in extremely low contrast and nearly unreadable text
issues.suggestion: Change banner text to a dark color with sufficient contrast (e.g., dark green or black) or darken the banner background to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements
